Definition: accepted species name (all datasets are human)
species label as carried in the EBRAINS dataset names ('[human, vX.Y]'); printed-name invariant
Julich-Brain Cytoarchitectonic Atlas (v3.0.3) region the fingerprint is anchored to in siibra (anchor string, e.g. 'Area hOc1 (V1, 17, CalcS)', 'CA1 (Hippocampus)')
Note: one anchor can carry several datasets (hippocampal CA1/CA2/CA3 x whole / stratum cellulare / stratum moleculare x v1.0 / v2.0; Area 44 and hOc2 dorsal / ventral parts); use dataset_locus + dataset_version to pick one

Definition: what the dataset itself measures, parsed from the dataset name ('... for <locus> [human, vX.Y]'): the area, or a part / stratum of it
Note: e.g. 'ventral part of Area 44 (IFG)', 'stratum cellulare of CA (Hippocampus)'

Definition: EBRAINS Knowledge Graph dataset name as returned by siibra (first dataset entry of the feature)
dataset version parsed from the dataset name (v1.0 or v2.0)
Note: v2.0 hippocampal datasets carry 14 receptors, their v1.0 predecessors 5; both kept

Definition: receptor, harmonised to the Supplementary Table 2 item names where identical: BZ -> GABAA/BZ; mGluR2_3 and mGluR2/3 -> mGluR2/3 (extra receptor, not in the 2017 table); all others unchanged (AMPA, NMDA, kainate, GABAA, GABAB, M1, M2, M3, alpha4beta2, alpha1, alpha2, 5-HT1A, 5-HT2, D1)
receptor label exactly as in the EBRAINS source TSV / siibra
receptor density, mean over the examined hemispheres/brains of the dataset, fmol/mg protein (EBRAINS unit 'fmol/mg')
Note: quantitative in vitro receptor autoradiography (Juelich INM-1 protocol); sample size per dataset is on the dataset's KG page, not in the TSV

Definition: standard deviation as given in the source TSV ('density (sd)')
number of receptors in the fingerprint (5, 14, 15 or 16)
DOI of the EBRAINS dataset the row comes from (https://doi.org/10.25493/...); join key of reference_tables/Zilles_PalomeroGallagher_2017_EBRAINSFingerprints_references.csv (ref_key)
Note: one value per row; split on '; ' if ever multiple

Definition: siibra feature id (dataset id -- anchor hash)
EBRAINS data-proxy URL of the TSV file siibra parsed the values from
siibra parcellation the features were queried for
fmol/mg protein kept (source unit; receptor-density measure class, no conversion)
one row = one EBRAINS dataset x receptor: an area-level (or hippocampal-stratum-level) mean over the dataset's brains; not a species or whole-brain value
constructed source: EBRAINS KG datasets fetched with siibra 1.0.1a27 (ReceptorDensityFingerprint features of Julich-Brain 3.0.3) on 2026-11-15; values are not printed in the 2017 paper
